name: Silicon Carbide (SiC) Power Semiconductors & Epi Wafers
scope: Silicon carbide wafers, epitaxy and power devices (MOSFETs, diodes, modules) for EV inverters, solar/grid, data-centre power and rail -- IndexBox (2026) projects ~18.5% CAGR for SiC substrates to 2035; India's first SiC fab/epi build-outs are now becoming real (RIR Power completed SiC epitaxial reactor installation in Bhubaneswar in Sep 2026; L&T Semiconductor unveiled its first 1200V SiC MOSFET platform at SEMICON India 2026), but listed exposure is thin, the pure-play (RIR, listed 16 Jul 2026) has not re-rated hard, and mainstream thematic coverage is still mostly about the generic 'chip stocks' basket, not SiC specifically.
questions: What is the SiC value chain (crystal/substrate, epitaxy, device fab, module packaging) and why is SiC displacing silicon in EV traction inverters, fast chargers, solar/storage inverters, grid and data-centre power? What do IndexBox and other market reports project for substrates and devices?
Where is India in that chain today -- what is imported (substrates, epi wafers, devices) and what is the policy support (ISM approvals, Odisha incentives, SEMICON India 2026 announcements)?

RIR Power Electronics (Ruttonsha International Rectifier): what exactly has been committed and done at the Bhubaneswar SiC facility (Rs 618 cr plan, Phase-1 capex ~Rs 65 cr, Odisha fiscal support, epitaxial reactor installation Sep 2026), what is the timeline to revenue, and how is it funded post its 16 Jul 2026 NSE listing?

L&T Semiconductor Technologies (subsidiary of Larsen & Toubro): what is its 1200V SiC MOSFET platform, is it fabless or fab-backed, who are the target customers, and how material can this become for L&T?

Kaynes Technology / Kaynes Semicon: Sanand OSAT is producing intelligent power modules; what has the company said about SiC-based devices in future phases, and what is the evidence (filings, presentations, EE Times coverage) versus inference?

Are there any other NSE/BSE-listed companies with company-confirmed SiC work (e.g. power-semiconductor, rectifier, crystal/abrasive-grade SiC or module makers)? Note that CDIL is unlisted and SiCSem is unlisted -- verify any additional name with a filing or presentation, not sector adjacency.
Which names are small, mid and large cap, and what share of each company's revenue or capex does SiC really represent today?

Has the market already priced this in? Stock performance since the RIR listing and over 6-12 months for RIR, L&T and Kaynes, and how much broker/mainstream media coverage names SiC specifically versus generic semiconductor baskets.

What are the key risks -- technology/yield gaps versus Wolfspeed, Infineon, ST, Chinese substrate price deflation, long gestation, customer qualification, funding and execution risk for a newly listed small cap?

What are the near-term catalysts (RIR Phase-1 commissioning, first device samples and customer qualifications, ISM/state incentives, L&T SiC tape-outs and orders, Kaynes SiC phase announcements, EV/solar demand data)?

sic_fab_and_epi: Companies building SiC epitaxy, wafer or device manufacturing in India
sic_design_and_packaging: Companies with SiC device platforms or power-module packaging that can extend to SiC
